messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing-metering-service detected token_count_delta ~+22% vs baseline for the last 10m in eu-west-1. Rule: windowing-aggregation-mismatch. Pager routed to #oncall-sre and billing-ops.
lucia-oncall: Ack, taking lead. Pinging ashok and tess. What's the quick read on customer-facing flags? :eyes:
ashok-sre: I see spikes in the emitter logs starting ~1719005400. There are bursts of duplicate events from edge-proxy v2.3.1 -> looks like batching keys not being deduped.
ashok-sre: Quick query I ran: ```SELECT region, count(distinct request_id) as unique, count(*) as raw FROM billing.events WHERE ts >= now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY region; -- eu-west-1 raw 1,245,900 unique 1,012,300``` so ~= +23% raw vs unique.
tess-billing: We're already getting noisy overage alerts for 6 customers (internal alerting). They see sudden token jump notifications. Putting customer list in case comms needed: cust-alpha, cust-kappa, cust-ignite.
marc-platform: Could be the recent proxy deploy that tweaked batching timeout. Rollback window on eu-west proxy available (manual), but that will lose some perf gains.
lucia-oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Enable emitter dedupe flag on billing-ingest (fast toggle) 2) Start backfill dedupe job to reconcile 15m window 3) Notify CS for customer comms. Any objections?
ashok-sre: No objections. I'm flipping the dedupe flag now on prod-canary -> eu-west -> then global. Command: ```kubectl set env deployment/billing-ingest DEDUPE_MODE=on -n prod-euw``` Will monitor.
incident-bot: action: set_env started by ashok-sre at 1719005752
ashok-sre: Done in eu-west canary. Observability: raw->unique delta dropped to +4% in canary region within 60s. Rolling to rest of eu-west.
tess-billing: Thanks — starting a customer advisory draft. Will wait for confirmation before sending to affected accounts.
marc-platform: Also kicking a short-lived consumer backfill: job name billing-dedupe-backfill-171900 to run with priority low. This will reconcile counts for the last 30m.
lucia-oncall: Can someone drop the exact list of affected alert ids so billing-ops can suppress noisy overage emails until we resolve?
billing-ops: Got the list. Suppressing outbound overage emails for the 6 affected accounts for the next 60 minutes. We'll attach a note: "Investigating billing telemetry; no confirmed charges yet." :white_check_mark:
ashok-sre: Rolling complete at 1719005870. Post-roll metrics look good. Raw vs unique within expected variance in eu-west and global rollout in progress.
lucia-oncall: Good work. Keeping this as a Sev-2 until backfill completes and we confirm no persistent drift. Next updates at +15m or on progress. :hand:
incident-bot: incident update: status=mitigating, severity=2, started=1719005678, update_ts=1719005889"
